data.body: **P2:** The continuation admission cut still occurs after the successful result has been serialized and any oversized-result checkpoint has completed. Once the handler future has won outcome selection, a READY continuation admitted during that preparation window can run, checkpoint, or fail without replacing the already-selected success, so the invocation may still report `SUCCEEDED`. Call `beginInvocationEnd()` immediately after selecting handler success, before result serialization/checkpointing, and add a regression test that blocks serialization while a queued READY continuation is released and fails.
